jobDescription: Senior Software Engineer Location: Bangalore, India About nference nference is an AI-first healthcare technology company dedicated to accelerating biomedical discovery and transforming healthcare through cutting-edge artificial intelligence and large-scale computing. Engineers are encouraged to challenge assumptions, contribute ideas, influence technical direction, and take ownership of their work from concept to production. Whether you're designing distributed systems, building cloud-native services, or developing AI-powered healthcare applications, you'll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in technology and healthcare. In this role, you'll design and develop cloud-native services, distributed systems, and APIs that power our AI-driven healthcare products. You'll collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, AI researchers, and domain experts to solve complex technical challenges while delivering software that has a direct impact on healthcare innovation. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys tackling large-scale engineering problems, values clean and maintainable code, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. What You'll Do Take ownership of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through deployment and maintenance. Build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs that support internal platform capabilities and system integrations. Design and implement robust, scalable backend systems with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, and performance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with platform goals. Review code, mentor junior engineers, and ensure adherence to engineering standards and best practices. Identify and resolve system bottlenecks while optimizing performance through caching, batching, and concurrency improvements. Contribute to testing strategies, including unit, integration, and automated testing, to ensure system reliability and prevent regressions. Monitor key system metrics such as latency, error rates, and throughput, and continuously improve backend performance. Contribute to High-Level Designs (HLDs) and maintain clear architecture and technical documentation. Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and engineering planning. Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve system reliability and observability. Drive engineering best practices and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 4–6 years of professional experience in backend engineering, platform engineering, or a related software engineering role. Strong proficiency in Python or Go, with Python preferred as the primary backend programming language. Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and backend design patterns. Strong database skills with PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. Working knowledge of NoSQL databases such as MongoDB. Hands-on experience with AWS (or similar cloud platforms), Docker, and Kubernetes. Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, event-driven systems, and backend performance optimization. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and Agile/Scrum development environments. Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and system design principles. Excellent analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing and building scalable distributed systems. Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ. Familiarity with Redis or distributed caching solutions. Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. Experience optimizing highly available, large-scale production systems. Exposure to machine learning infrastructure or data-intensive applications. Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design discussions. Contributions to open-source projects are a plus. Why Join nference? At nference, you'll work on technology that has the potential to transform healthcare and improve lives across the world. Every engineering challenge you solve contributes to advancing biomedical research, accelerating drug discovery, and enabling better clinical decisions. You'll be part of a team that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, where you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, solve complex engineering problems, and grow alongside some of the brightest minds in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and life sciences. If you're excited about building software that matters and want your work to create meaningful real-world impact, nference is the place for you. Benefits & Perks Industry Prestige: Build your career at the "Google of Biomedicine" (as recognized by The Washington Post), working alongside exceptional software engineers, physicians, scientists, and researchers. Cutting-Edge Innovation: Solve complex healthcare challenges using advanced AI, machine learning, and large-scale clinical, molecular, and imaging datasets. Meaningful Impact: Contribute to technologies that accelerate drug discovery and biomedical research, with opportunities to be recognized as a contributing author on high-impact scientific publications where applicable. You'll collaborate with experts across engineering, clinical, and research teams while contributing to products that have a meaningful impact on patient care and biomedical discovery. The Opportunity We're looking for an Imaging Analyst who is passionate about medical imaging, anatomy, and precision data annotation. In this role, you'll work with multimodal radiology datasets to create accurate annotations, segmentations, and landmark labels that support the development of AI-powered healthcare solutions. You'll collaborate closely with radiologists, AI researchers, software engineers, and clinical scientists to produce high-quality imaging datasets while adhering to rigorous annotation standards and quality processes. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with medical images, has exceptional attention to detail, and wants to contribute to the future of healthcare AI. What You'll Do Perform high-quality annotations across multiple medical imaging modalities, including CT, MR, PT, US, and other radiology datasets. Segment anatomical and neuroanatomical structures using established annotation protocols and quality standards. Perform high-precision landmark placement for neuroimaging datasets. Interpret MRI sequences to accurately identify anatomical structures and tissue characteristics. Utilize ITK / ITK-SNAP for volumetric segmentation, multi-planar visualization, and image registration validation. Work with OHIF Viewer to review DICOM studies, DICOM-SEG overlays, and annotation workflows. Perform quality assurance checks to ensure annotation accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Collaborate with radiologists, clinical experts, AI researchers, and software engineers to continuously improve annotation quality and workflows. Maintain annotation documentation and follow standard operating procedures. Contribute to the development of high-quality datasets that enable AI-driven medical imaging solutions. What We're Looking For Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Medical Imaging, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Radiography, Medical Technology, Anatomy, Neuroscience, or a related technical discipline. General Foundational Anatomical Literacy: Core understanding of spatial orientation, tissue laterality, and multi-planar cross-sectional anatomy across axial, sagittal, and coronal views. Ability to cleanly distinguish gross anatomical boundaries, bone interfaces, and background air to establish a reliable baseline. Annotation experience of all radiology modalities like CT, MR, PT, US, and others. Brain Foundational Neuroanatomical Literacy: Ability to segment 33 semantic structures like the cortex and brainstem on multi-planar MRI. Annotators must accurately isolate deep grey nuclei and navigate complex boundaries like the hippocampal-amygdala transition. High-Precision Neuro Landmark Placement: Proficiency placing 24 point landmarks within a strict ≤ 1 mm target window of spatial error. Annotators must follow protocols for AC-PC alignment, cortical extremes, and deep grey matter surgical targets. Sequence-Specific Image Interpretation: Mastery of MRI contrast differences to leverage T1w series for anatomy and bony landmarks. Annotators must utilize T2w series for fluid-containing structures, ventricles, and global CSF boundaries. Software Proficiency with ITK / ITK-SNAP: Expertise utilizing ITK environments for volumetric 3D segmentation, multi-planar visualization, and 6-DOF registration checks. Annotators must accurately export final masks as 16-bit integer NIfTI-1 (.nii.gz) volumes. Web-Based DICOM Operations via OHIF Viewer: Competency utilizing OHIF tools to navigate raw DICOM series, display DICOM-SEG overlays, and manage workflows. Annotators must use point tools to capture exact 3D RAS coordinates for JSON sidecar export. Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently produce accurate, high-quality annotations. Excellent analytical, observational, and problem-solving skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience working on large-scale medical imaging annotation projects. Familiarity with AI-assisted medical imaging workflows. Experience with medical image quality assurance and validation processes. Exposure to neuroimaging research or clinical imaging workflows. Experience working with multidisciplinary teams including radiologists, researchers, and AI engineers. Contributions to medical imaging research or scientific publications are a plus. title: Technical Operations Engineer
jobDescription: Senior Technical Operations Engineer Keep production healthy. Keep research moving. 🛠️ About nference Healthcare creates an unbelievable amount of data every single day. Clinical notes. Lab results. Medical images. Molecular data. Most of it exists in places and formats that make it hard to connect, search, and actually learn from. At nference, we’re changing that. Working with leading medical institutions, we turn large-scale biomedical data into structured, research-ready systems. Using AI and high-performance computing, we help bridge what’s happening in patients with what’s happening at the molecular level, accelerating discovery in diagnostics, treatments, and precision medicine. Big mission. Real engineering. The Role 👩‍💻 You'll join the Technical Operations team and help keep the platforms powering our products reliable, stable, and available. Production systems. Incident response. Infrastructure. Reliability. Automation. You'll investigate issues, troubleshoot production environments, improve operational workflows, and work closely with engineering teams to keep critical systems running smoothly. Translation: you'll be the reason production stays healthy when it matters most. What You'll Do 🚀 Monitor production systems and infrastructure, investigating alerts and service disruptions across multiple environments Troubleshoot production issues, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and identify long-term fixes Act as the secondary escalation point for operational incidents and support IC-1 engineers during critical issues Own the incident lifecycle from investigation and escalation to resolution and post-incident documentation Partner with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams to diagnose issues and implement reliable fixes Support application releases, patches, and configuration changes while ensuring production stability Analyze system performance and operational metrics to identify reliability improvements Build automation scripts using Python, Bash, or Shell to improve operational efficiency Mentor IC-1 TechOps engineers and support onboarding and incident handling best practices Document operational procedures and troubleshooting guides so future-you (and everyone else) says thank you You'll Probably Enjoy This If 🛠️ You have 1-4 years of experience in Technical Operations, Production Support, Infrastructure Support, or System Administration Linux feels like home, and you're comfortable debugging services, analyzing logs, and troubleshooting production systems You automate repetitive work using Python, Bash, or Shell Monitoring tools like Prometheus or Grafana help you understand what's happening before users notice You've worked with AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, or modern cloud infrastructure Databases, networking fundamentals, and web services are familiar territory Git is part of your everyday workflow You enjoy solving complex production problems and improving system reliability You communicate clearly and collaborate well across engineering teams Why Join ✨ 🧠 Strong people, low ego Work alongside talented engineers, researchers, MDs, and PhDs solving challenging problems together. We value collaboration, curiosity, and great ideas over hierarchy. 📈 Scale that's actually interesting Build solutions for large biomedical datasets, modern cloud infrastructure, and real-world engineering challenges where performance and reliability matter. 🔬 Work with impact Build technology that accelerates biomedical research, supports scientific discovery, and advances healthcare innovation. 🏡 Hybrid + flexibility Enjoy a hybrid work model after probation, balancing in-person collaboration with focused remote work. 🎁 Good perks, not gimmicks Gym, technology, internet, and learning reimbursements, plus complimentary breakfast, lunch, and snacks at the office. If your ideal day includes solving production puzzles, automating repetitive work, and keeping critical systems running smoothly, we should talk!

title: Associate Product Manager
jobDescription: About Us: At nFerence Labs, the "Google of Biomedicine" (See also nference.ai/news for more information on our research work especially pertaining to Covid19), we are building the world's first massive-scale platform for pharmaco-biomedical computing. Our platform is premised on using AI/Deep Learning (on clinical text, medical images, and other signals) and massive high-performance computing to help pharma companies perform faster and more efficient drug discovery, and also help early diagnosis of several key diseases. We collaborate heavily with premier medical institutions such as the Mayo Clinic and build systems to get deep medical insights from patient information including patient notes and lab information, medical images, ECGs, etc. We are a well-funded company and are looking to grow on all fronts. Our team is a blend of CS folks and domain experts (biological science and medical MDs, PhDs, etc) constituting a unique community built of alumni from the likes of MIT, Harvard, the IITs, IISc, and other premier institutions. What are we looking for: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Product Manager to join our team, specializing in Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) products. As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for leading the development and implementation of our product roadmap. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to define product requirements, prioritize features, and drive the successful delivery of SaaS solutions to market. Responsibilities: Develop and maintain a deep understanding of customer needs and market trends within the SaaS industry. Define and prioritize product features and enhancements based on strategic goals, customer feedback, and competitive analysis specific to the SaaS market. Collaborate closely with engineering and design teams to ensure product requirements are clearly defined and implemented effectively in the context of SaaS architecture. Drive the agile development process for SaaS products, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management tailored to SaaS deployment models. Champion the SaaS product vision and roadmap within the organization, ensuring alignment with company objectives and the evolving needs of SaaS customers. Stay informed about industry trends and best practices specific to SaaS products and platforms to identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation. Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including executives, to provide updates on SaaS product status and gather feedback. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred. Proven experience 3 Years working as a Product Manager in the SaaS industry, with a strong track record of successfully launching and growing SaaS products. Deep understanding of SaaS business models, metrics, and customer acquisition/retention strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making specific to SaaS products. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams in the context of SaaS development and deployment. Experience with agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira or Trello, adapted for SaaS product lifecycle management. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously, with a focus on SaaS product delivery. Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a track record of driving results and influencing cross-functional teams in the context of SaaS product development. Knowledge of cloud computing technologies, APIs, and integrations relevant to SaaS product architecture is a plus. Bonus: A solid background in software engineering or data science, with the capability to collaborate closely with the engineering team by engaging in meaningful technical discussions, providing insights, and effectively bridging business and technical perspectives. Collaborate with clinical, engineering, and data science teams to translate healthcare domain insights into product strategies, ensuring compliance with regulations while enhancing patient and provider experiences. Benefits: Be a part of “Google of biomedicine” as recognized by the Washington Post Work with some of the brilliant minds of the world solving exciting real world problems through Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, analytics and insights through triangulating unstructured and structured information from the biomedical literature as well as from large scale molecular and real world datasets. Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as stock options, paid time off, healthcare insurance, gym/broadband reimbursement.
